items_flat.title_en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Calls for Containing Super Intelligence as Insider Risks
items_flat.title_zh: 微軟CEO納德拉呼籲將超級智能視為內部風險加以控制
items_flat.summary_en: In an October 10 X post titled 'Models as Insider Risks in the Super Intelligence Era,' Satya Nadella argued that frontier models lack mechanistic traceability like traditional software and should not be treated as trusted black boxes. He proposed separating the supply of intelligence from authority over it, surrounding non-deterministic models with deterministic controls, human oversight, and an emergency brake.
items_flat.summary_zh: 納德拉於10月10日在X發布貼文《超級智能時代的模型作為內部風險》，指出前沿模型缺乏傳統軟體的機制可追溯性，不應視為可信黑箱。他主張將智能供應與對其的權威分離，並以確定性控制、人類監督與緊急剎車包圍非確定性模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: This frames deployment safety as an enterprise engineering problem rather than pure model alignment, potentially accelerating demand for external harnesses and audit tools while highlighting Microsoft's position as a major AI customer and Azure provider. Uncertainty remains on whether labs will adopt standardized external controls or if competitive pressures will override the call.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將部署安全定位為企業工程問題而非純模型對齊，可能加速外部 harness 與審計工具需求，同時凸顯微軟作為主要AI客戶與Azure供應商的立場。不確定性在於實驗室是否會採納標準化外部控制，或競爭壓力是否會壓過此呼籲。
items_flat.quote: We can’t treat Super Intelligence as a set of nested black boxes and simply accept or reject its recommendations, answers, and actions. We must build contained systems whose behavior we can observe, limits we can test, and actions we can always contain.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們不能將超級智能視為一組嵌套黑箱，單純接受或拒絕其建議、答案與行動。我們必須建立行為可觀察、限制可測試、行動始終可控制的封閉系統。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk Says Grok Bot Can Research Deals and Order Online from a Credit Card Photo
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克稱Grok Bot可從信用卡照片研究最佳價格並完成線上訂購
items_flat.summary_en: On October 10-11, Elon Musk posted that users can photograph a credit card, drop it in Grok Bot chat, and have the agent scour the internet for the best deal and complete the purchase. He demonstrated by asking it to research and order Lego Star Wars kits for kids, noting it bought from the LEGO website after Amazon blocked agents.
items_flat.summary_zh: 10月10-11日，馬斯克發文稱用戶可拍攝信用卡照片丟入Grok Bot聊天，讓代理搜尋網路最佳價格並完成購買。他示範要求研究並訂購兒童樂高星際大戰套組，指出在亞馬遜封鎖代理後，它從樂高官網購買。
items_flat.analysis_en: This expands Grok Bot's agentic actions into real-world commerce, testing user trust in autonomous spending, but media reports note his demo screenshot exposed partial address and card details, underscoring privacy and confirmation risks despite documented approval flows. It remains unclear how broadly the photo-to-order path is implemented versus existing Stripe Link confirmations.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將Grok Bot的代理行動擴展至現實商務，測試用戶對自主消費的信任，但媒體報導指出其示範截圖暴露部分地址與卡片細節，凸顯隱私與確認風險，即使有文件化的批准流程。照片到下單路徑的實際廣度相對現有Stripe Link確認仍不清楚。
items_flat.quote: To buy stuff, you can just take a picture of your credit card, drop it in the chat and Grok @Bot will scour the Internet for the best deal on the item you want and order it.
items_flat.quote_zh: 要買東西，你只要拍一張信用卡照片丟進聊天，Grok @Bot就會搜尋網路找出你想要的物品最佳價格並訂購。

brief_en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella called for treating Super Intelligence models as insider risks with external containment and an emergency brake. xAI's Elon Musk promoted Grok Bot's ability to research deals and complete online purchases, including from a credit card photo.
brief_zh: 微軟CEO納德拉呼籲將超級智能模型視為內部風險，需外部控制與緊急剎車。xAI的馬斯克推廣Grok Bot可研究最佳價格並完成線上購物，包括從信用卡照片下單。
